note: D4 slot 1 is upgrade_or_affinity: the tidewarden kit holds three upgradable bases, but mycelium_dash+ is pure mobility and deepens no build, so the slot candidates are [water_jet+, seed_bomb+] (d4_upgrade_filter.json pins that filter) and it reports upgrade - water_jet+ here, picked, which replaces the base in place (draft_upgrade, not a kit slot spent). The role falls back to the affinity list only when no held base has a build-defining + form left, and under the upgrades_only mutator every slot collapses to that list (c4_upgrades_only). Offer 0 is the affinity slot on the same seed and board as d4_affinity_slot: the set is {water, displace, growth} here, so it deals vine_whip (displace) where the flarekeeper gets moss_filter (sun). Pre-D4 this seed dealt bramble_coat, sun_flare, thorn_shield to the tidewarden - and the identical three ids to the default tender kit, because the old roll could not tell the two runs apart
